description: Animation tables of the story characters in the cutscenes of map3_s06 (Hospital - 1F after Otherworld). A cutscene asks whether a character's animation is done ("playback") and which keyframe it starts at ("start_keyframe"; the same tables as playback when absent); the answer comes from the table named here, a file gamedata/tables/anim/<table>.json indexed by the character's animation status. "tables" maps a character name to its table and "fallback" is the table of every character not listed (none: such a character has no table). On this map, playback: every character uses "dahlia". "cue_sounds" sets the volume (0..255) of sounds (names of gamedata/sounds) that an animation keyframe cues: dahlia_cue_map2_s01 and dahlia_cue_3 at 64; any other cued sound plays at 128. Read when the map loads.
